command: set -euo pipefail; docker compose -f deploy/compose/docker-compose.test.yml up -d --wait; export RICCON_TEST_SERVICES=external RICCON_TEST_SERVICES_NAMESPACE=ops0151; node scripts/test-services.mjs prepare --namespace "$RICCON_TEST_SERVICES_NAMESPACE"; ./mvnw -q -T1C verify jacoco:report; if ./mvnw -q -pl apps/api jacoco:check@check-coverage -Dcoverage.line.minimum=1.01; then echo NEGATIVE_DRILL_UNEXPECTED_PASS; exit 1; else echo NEGATIVE_DRILL_OK_JACOCO_CHECK_EXIT_NONZERO; fi; ruby -ryaml -e 'YAML.load_file(".github/workflows/ci.yml"); puts "yaml ok"'; grep -q 'uses: actions/checkout@v7' .github/workflows/ci.yml; grep -q 'uses: actions/setup-java@v6' .github/workflows/ci.yml; grep -q 'uses: actions/setup-node@v7' .github/workflows/ci.yml; grep -q 'uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7' .github/workflows/ci.yml; grep -q 'uses: actions/download-artifact@v8' .github/workflows/ci.yml; grep -q 'uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6' .github/workflows/ci.yml; if grep -Eq 'checkout@v[0-6]|setup-java@v[0-5]|setup-node@v[0-6]|upload-artifact@v[0-6]|download-artifact@v[0-7]|action-setup@v[0-5]' .github/workflows/ci.yml; then echo OLD_ACTION_FOUND; exit 1; fi; test "$(grep -c 'uses: actions/checkout@v7' .github/workflows/ci.yml)" -eq 6; test "$(grep -c 'uses: actions/setup-java@v6' .github/workflows/ci.yml)" -eq 4; test "$(grep -c 'uses: actions/setup-node@v7' .github/workflows/ci.yml)" -eq 4; test "$(grep -c 'uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7' .github/workflows/ci.yml)" -eq 5; git diff --check; echo LOCAL_EVIDENCE_OK
note: M22/TASK-0151 本地：external namespace ops0151 canonical verify 通过；负向演练 -Dcoverage.line.minimum=1.01 使 jacoco:check 非 0 退出；YAML 解析与 actions 版本断言通过
